points.description: The award is final and not yet applied. L[0x1] holds the experience the unit receives: G[0x62ccb] after the G[0x3302] multiplier bits (0x10 zero, 0x20 double, 0x40 tenfold). current_unit_id is the canonical unit. All three multiplier paths jump here, so `before site` sees every award and may rewrite L[0x1].
